asr.full_text: In 2021, PM Modi targeted urban poverty. He advocated a lot, but this year PM's another target, Pashim Mangal, will be in the list. In the Bengo war in 2021, a new challenge is being faced by an elderly woman. There is once again Shubhendu Adhikari, who has been facing a massive revolt against Mamata. Shubhendu Adhikari will give Mamata another shock today. After Shubhendu, his younger brother Somhindu Adhikari is going to give Mamta an extra kick today. After Shubhindu, her younger brother Suvmiddu Adhikari will also be joining the BJP. Besides this many TMC leaders and activists will join the BJP today. Earlier, in December 2020, Shubhindu Adhikari became part of the BJP with six state officials. Now it is time to move on to family matters. I mean Shubhindu is preparing to lay his hands on the turn of his family. That But we still have not gotten any news of the state of politics. The political arena where our elections happened was still busy and full of people. And the political arena where our elections happened was still packed with politicians. Today, the political arena where our elections happened is filled with many politicians. Let me take you through the scene A new soldier has emerged in Bengal In the political language of Bengal's Bhangva A new camel has blossomed This is the hero of Modi's Maharashtra And the enemy of BJP Bengal was proficient in politics but because of god all the country is looking at Shubhindu Who are the leaders of these two parties? And how heavy are they on TMS? We want change! Next time, 200 times! Long live BJP! Long live Bharat Mahatma Gandhi! Move the Kala Baj Bhai! Long live Shri Ram! Long live Shri Ram! Long live Krishna! Long live Krishna! Long live Krishna! Modi ji is fighting for change. This is a new wave. When elections come, it will be a tsunami. Bengal people have decided to But when the media asked questions, Shubhendu replied with great sincerity. There were only five Jatt, only three knew me. They said hello to me, so I bowed my head in reply. We saw five Jatt, three of them were of the same age, they were from Tumskarpuri. We saw the Dara, and we said hello to them. Shubhendu was doing a roadshow in Bhairakpur. This is the area of the BJP's powerful MP Arjun Singh who came from TMC. Even in this rally, the mountains of Jaysh Ram were being covered. But on that same day, Nandigram's success is written by this wise man. This wise man made Shubhendu the suitable boy of BJP in Bengal. Cadder-based parties do not look at the horoscope of the workers. But the king of BJP, looking at the time, Midnapur, to include Shubhendu. Shubhendu was welcomedikari said in a rally in Nandigram that I am born in a honest Brahmin family. Whatever I do, I do it with great honesty. I have faith in my religion and when I am a representative of a people, then I do my work with great honesty. Some people presented Shubhendu's statement after joining BJP as a change. Whereas Shubhendu is saying it as a duty of Brahmin and honesty. How much is the importance of affection in a political war? You three boys won't be able to survive without you. We will be able to survive with our honor. Let's say, move your brother to Talabaz. Move your brother to Talabaz. Move your brother to Talabaz. It is easy to say in a conversation that the family is like a consistent success in Bengal politics. Shubhendu, 50 years old, has only climbed the ladder of success in 15 years of politics. In 2006, he became the TMC secretary for the first time from the Kanti Dakshin seat. After the successful movement in 2007, he became the leader of Nandi Gram. In 2009, he was happy and gave a ticket from Mamata to Tamluk Nandi Gram became the leader of the party. In 2009, Mamta was happy that she got a ticket from Tamluk and became an MP. In the 2014 elections, Shubhendu was still in control of Tamluk seat. In the 2016 elections, Nandi Gram became the leader except for Lok Sabha. In 2016, Mamta made him a minister and he became the second most respected connected to the public. Bengal is a sentimental province. This sentiment is evident in voting. Shubhendu understood this sentiment from the students' politics. He did not stop once he held his breath. This is the reason why the love for Shubhendu is visible. The poster of Aami Dadar Onugami, that is, I am the supporter of Dada... ...and Shubhendu Adhikari Fans Club... BJP's president is dying here. He is dying every day. We read in the paper that he is dying every day. Why is he dying? No state is supporting him. So, the goon kingdom has been formed. Politicians are made big by the people. If the population is big and if it is established for a decade and a half, then what is there to say? Amit Shah first felt this power of Shubhendu. Jai Shri Ram! Jai Shri Ram! Jai Jai Shri Ram! In the East-Midnapur district, apart from 16 seats, 18 seats of West-Midnapur, 12 seats of Bankura, 9 seats of Purulia, 22 seats of Murshidabad and 12 seats of Malda, the majority is the influence of the officials and their families. In Murshidabad and Malda, as a party on the eve of election, Shubhindu included the leaders of Congress. Here is a break. After the break, let's see how Kohre created a commotion on the highways.
